opportunities.title: Main Grants (Research, Development and Analysis Fund)

amount.raw: up to £500,000 (up to £750,000 in special cases, by prior agreement); most grants below £300,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based organisations. Not open to individuals without formal employment/contractual relationship with the hosting institution, projects led by individuals unaffiliated to an organisation, schools or further education colleges, undergraduates or master's students, or projects led by organisations not based in the UK (exceptional overseas cases possible).
opportunities.summary: Funding for research projects that address one or more of the Foundation's five priority questions and aim to improve lives in the UK. Two application deadlines a year (Spring and Autumn).

opportunities.title: Racial Diversity UK Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based applicants; encourages applicants from diverse backgrounds, particularly individuals and organisations from racially minoritised communities, and partnership applications bringing together researchers and racially minoritised communities.
opportunities.summary: Research funding to understand the barriers and pathways to a racially just and inclusive society. 2026 priority theme: inter-generational changes, continuities and challenges in racially diverse UK. One deadline a year in Autumn.
